title: 777. Swap Adjacent in LR String

examples.explanation: A sequence of allowed slides reshapes the first row into the second one.
An empty slot cannot become a token.
The L steps one slot left into the empty cell.

hints: Ignore the empty slots first: after deleting every X, the remaining L/R order must match exactly.
Track positions of the remaining tokens: each L in the start must not sit to the right of its counterpart in the target, and each R must not sit to the left.
Scan both strings with two pointers that skip over X characters and compare token by token.
